FetchContent_Declare(googletest
    GIT_REPOSITORY https://github.com/google/googletest.git
    GIT_TAG v1.15.2
    GIT_SHALLOW TRUE)
set(gtest_force_shared_crt ON CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(INSTALL_GTEST OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
FetchContent_MakeAvailable(googletest)

add_executable(pendulum_tests
    test_smoke.cpp
    test_reference_data.cpp
    test_physics.cpp
    test_control.cpp
)
target_link_libraries(pendulum_tests PRIVATE pendulum_core GTest::gtest_main nlohmann_json::nlohmann_json)
# Golden reference data generated by cpp/reference/*.py (Phase 1).
target_compile_definitions(pendulum_tests PRIVATE
    PENDULUM_REFERENCE_DIR="${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../reference/data")

include(GoogleTest)
gtest_discover_tests(pendulum_tests)
